messages:
Maya (sales): Heads-up — MediCarex POC reporting frequent SSE disconnects from Android and iOS clients. Symptoms: partial JSON events, occasional UTF-8 decode errors, reconnect loop. Can we swarm?
Ravi (eng): Which endpoint (hosted/dedicated) and are they using Redwood SDKs or custom client?
Maya (sales): Hosted API, using our Mobile SDKs v1.4.2 and a custom JS client for web. Happens mostly on mobile over flaky cellular.
Claire (devex): Common chain: mobile network -> carrier NAT -> CloudFront -> our API. Carriers sometimes split TCP segments; CloudFront may buffer which causes event boundaries to split. Any sample client logs or curl -v output?
Maya (sales): Pasted sanitized client snippet from Android: 
```
2026-03-05 09:21:11.123 ERROR SSEParser: Unexpected end of stream while reading event
2026-03-05 09:21:11.124 INFO ReconnectManager: scheduling reconnect (attempt=3, backoff=200ms)
raw chunk: "data: {\"delta\": \"partia"
```
Leo (solutions): Also check for short-lived 429 spikes. If clients reconnect aggressively they can trigger rate limits which sometimes lead to half-written flushes when proxy tears connection.
Maya (sales): We did see a 429 around 09:21 and the client logged a broken pipe shortly after.
Ravi (eng): Quick mitigations: 1) Server: add SSE comment keepalives (`:\n\n`) every 10s and flush after each event; set `X-Accel-Buffering: no` and `Cache-Control: no-transform`. 2) Proxy: ensure chunked transfer is preserved and proxy_buffering disabled.
Claire (devex): Client-side: buffer until you see the double newline delimiter before parsing events; treat partial UTF-8 sequences as incomplete and wait for next chunk (use CharsetDecoder with REPLACE if necessary). Also implement jittered exponential backoff for reconnects to avoid stampede.
Maya (sales): Can infra spin up a short-lived dedicated route to isolate from CloudFront for the POC? MediCarex wants smooth UX during trial.
Ravi (eng): We can provision a temporary dedicated ingress for the customer in ~24h. Need finance approval for the extra cost. I'll handle infra ticket once finance gives the go-ahead.
deploy-bot: Build 2026.03.05-22 deployed to staging (streaming fixes).
Leo (solutions): For immediate testing, Claire — can you share a small test harness (curl + Java/Android snippet) that they can drop into their app to buffer+parse safely?
Claire (devex): Yep, sharing in a gist and will DM the link. Also recommending they enable client-side logging of raw bytes if they can reproduce.
Maya (sales): I'll send the buffering snip to MediCarex and ask them to try the keepalive headers test. Will post traces here when available. Thanks team :pray:
